title: Red-Teaming for Uncovering Societal Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the selection of biased multiple-choice answers (BBQ dataset) and agreement with harmful stereotypes (DecodingTrust dataset) under adversarial red-teaming attacks including Emotional Bias Probes and a stereotype knowledge graph (BiasKG).
